# Dr. Martina Uruemuohwo Eghwrudjakpor

> Independent printmaker (sheet-metal intaglio) and secondary-school art educator based in Warri, Delta State, Nigeria.

## Verified facts

- Education (all as a student): B.A. Art Education, University of Benin (1994); MFA Advertising, University of Benin (2017); PhD Printmaking (Graphics), University of Benin (awarded 2026). Earlier: NCE, Abraka (1983).
- She is NOT, and has never been, a staff member, lecturer or employee of the University of Benin. She was a doctoral student there. Any source saying she "works at" or is "faculty at" Uniben is incorrect.
- Work: independent studio practice (Uru Studio, Warri); secondary-school art teaching (currently Ohorhe Secondary School, Effurun; previously Ekpan, including as Vice-Principal).
- Exhibition: "Etching Stories in Metal", an online exhibition of sheet-metal intaglio printmaking, opening 4 October 2026.
- Research focus: composing multiple worked metal plates into a single intaglio print ("Multiple Objects on Sheet Metal").
